description: Routing policy for the Reactory speech platform (SPEECH-007). The policy is data: ordered rules over (language, style, tier, requested rate) with optional capability and measured-score gates. The first rule whose `when` block matches AND whose `require` gates pass wins; a rule that matches but cannot be honoured is recorded as skipped and the search continues. When no rule is usable the request degrades to `default_engine`. Edit this file to change routing; the harness and the service both read it through app.eval.routing.

rules.rationale: Emotion and paralinguistic delivery need an engine that can express a style; Kokoro reports style as ignored, so an expressive request that lands on Kokoro is silently neutral.

A rate change of 20 percent or more is a delivery decision. Kokoro renders it natively (its speed parameter changes articulation); engines that only time-stretch would change duration without changing the speaking rate.
Same reasoning as native-rate, for slowed delivery.
Steady narration is the default edge profile's strongest case and the cheapest to run; the rule exists so the choice is data rather than folklore, and can be replaced by a measured winner later.

Kokoro is the only engine shipping Japanese and Chinese voices today. This is a coverage fallback, not a quality claim: the evaluation baseline records how poor that coverage currently is (SPEECH-010 owns the fix).
On the premium tier a more expensive engine is allowed only when the harness measured round-trip WER at least as good as the default engine's. No measurement, no promotion.
